notes: Shure Microflex MX412/MX418/MX424 series gooseneck electret condenser microphone; the /C suffix denotes the cardioid cartridge (18-inch gooseneck length for MX418). Single physical I/O: an integrated 3-pin male XLR connector on the base of the preamplifier that carries BOTH the active-balanced mic-level audio output and the phantom power feed (11-52 VDC, 2.0 mA per official spec) — there is no separate power inlet, so no distinct power port is listed. Connector grade omitted: analog XLR mic-level audio is not one of the bandwidth-graded connector types. Desktop/podium/lectern-mount device (flange or shock-mount installed), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Official Shure user-guide confirms: Type = Electret Condenser, Frequency Response 50-17,000 Hz, Output Impedance 180 ohms, Output Configuration = Active Balanced, polarity spec explicitly references "pin 2 relative to pin 3 of output XLR connector" confirming the 3-pin XLR male output. Secondary retailer (Markertek) corroborates "Attached XLR Preamp" and the same 11-52 Vdc/2.0mA phantom spec.
